steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.

bins: skill with no one holding it
steps.note: Rank. Each role is placed by its gap and whether an action closes it, and each skill by who holds it.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

findings.title: Role gap with no action
findings.fix: Name the hiring or development action

findings.title: Demand with no source
findings.fix: Name the source of the demand

findings.title: Skill no one holds
findings.fix: Plan a hire or training for the skill

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (1 high, 1 medium, 1 low).
[high] gap-role-2.md:12  Role gap with no action.
       Fix: Name the hiring or development action.
[medium] plan-document.md:19  Demand with no source.
       Fix: Name the source of the demand.
[low] supply-skills.csv:26  Skill no one holds.
       Fix: Plan a hire or training for the skill.
Not checked: Market supply beyond the data.
pros: Checks a role with a gap and no action, a demand with no source, and a skill with no one holding it.
cons: Not checked: Market supply beyond the data.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-hr-workforce-plan skill on the records for this review.
